speaker: pico
text: Bye, friends! Good luck with the music box!

speaker: lumi
text: Thank you, Pico! To the music castle!

speaker: lumi
text: Wow... but why is it so quiet?

speaker: bobo
text: Hello-o! ...Hey! Where's my echo?

speaker: kiko
text: Plink, plonk! Kiko's invisible piano!

speaker: draco
text: Stand back! Dragon music magic!

speaker: bobo
text: Even my stomach makes more music than this castle!

speaker: melody
text: Oh! Visitors! Hello, hello! I'm Melody!

speaker: melody
text: I guard the Magical Music Box, but its melody is lost!

speaker: melody
text: Let me show you how it goes. Ahem!

speaker: kiko
text: Was that a song or a sleepy dinosaur?

speaker: melody
text: It was supposed to be a beautiful melody!

speaker: lumi
text: Look! The symbols glow in a pattern!

speaker: draco
text: Step aside! I'm a natural!

speaker: bobo
text: I don't know the song, but my feet definitely do!

speaker: melody
text: The Hall of Instruments! Touch one, and it sings!

speaker: draco
text: Maestro Draco will conduct! Orchestra, follow me!

speaker: bobo
text: I think I just played the world's biggest banana drum!

speaker: melody
text: Oh no! Three notes are missing from the music box!

speaker: lumi
text: These bells go low to high, like little stairs!

speaker: draco
text: I knew my musical talent would help!

speaker: kiko
text: You were making sounds like a broken trumpet!

speaker: melody
text: The last note must be sung... what if I ruin it?

speaker: lumi
text: Sing from your heart, Melody. We believe in you!

speaker: bobo
text: Ooh! A tiny golden banana music box!

speaker: lumi
text: Another magical mystery! Let's discover where that garden leads!

speaker: narrator
text: Next time... the secret of the floating flower garden!

speaker: melody
text: Laaa.

text: Aaaah.
